question: A fixed electric dipole of moment $\vec{p}$ is at the origin, aligned with the positive x-axis. A particle of mass $m$ and charge $-q$ is constrained to move on a circular path of radius $r$ centered at the origin. If the particle is given an initial velocity $v_0$ at the point $(r, 0)$ on the x-axis, what will its speed be when it reaches the point $(0, r)$ on the y-axis?
